verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Trigger.dev can send outbound webhook alerts when tasks fail (docs-29) and supports many trigger types (scheduled, API calls, waitpoint tokens), but there is no documentation of an inbound webhook subscription mechanism that lets a task be triggered by external events via webhooks. This is a fair axis for a background-jobs/workflow platform, but no evidence shows it delivers 'subscribe to events via webhooks' as a capability.
